proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_reroll
proposed_widenings.justification: Luck fires only when a natural 1 is rolled on a D20 Test and allows a single reroll that must be kept. This is mechanically distinct from advantage (which rolls 2d20 and takes the higher before the roll resolves) and from modify_roll_numeric (an additive bonus). The trigger is a specific die-face result, not a blanket before-roll enhancement. The v4 taxonomy lists modify_roll_reroll as an effect atom but it is absent from types.ts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, you can reroll the die, and you must use the new roll.

notes: The mechanic is a conditional reroll gated on a specific die result (natural 1) covering all D20 Tests (attack rolls, saving throws, ability checks). The passive family and species_trait kind both exist and would fit — the only blocker is the missing modify_roll_reroll atom. The proposed atom needs at minimum: a trigger condition (roll_value: 1), the set of roll kinds it applies to (all D20 Tests), and 'must use new roll' semantics (no keep-or-reroll choice). Note: the broader Halfling species entry also includes Brave (encodable as modify_roll_advantage with conditionFilter frightened), Halfling Nimbleness (no atom — special movement through spaces), and Naturally Stealthy (no atom — conditional Hide action grant). Only Luck is surveyed here.
